issues.detail: The Greek text includes 'αἰγύπτον' (Egypt), which is completely missing from the Vietnamese translation. The Vietnamese text lists 'Phry-gi', 'Pam-phi-ly', and 'Li-by', but skips Egypt.

The Greek 'επιδημουντες' (sojourners/resident aliens) is rendered as 'những người... đến đó' (people who came there), which loses the specific nuance of being a resident alien or sojourner within those lands.
